# Inventory 360

> High-performance, local-first retail enterprise POS terminal, multi-outlet stock tracking, autonomous purchase orders, and financial analytics powered by browser IndexedDB.

Inventory 360 is an open-source, local-first retail enterprise workspace providing point-of-sale terminals, inventory tracking, multi-outlet stock balancing, barcode scanning, ESC/POS thermal printing, and analytics with 100% offline data sovereignty.

## Core Documentation & Application Routes

- [Inventory 360 Application](https://www.inventory360.shop/): Main local-first retail operations workspace and POS terminal.
- [Engineering & Strategy Blog](https://www.inventory360.shop/blog): In-depth retail architecture guides, turnover formulas, and hardware tutorials.
- [Privacy Policy & Data Security](https://www.inventory360.shop/privacy): Zero-telemetry, client-side IndexedDB encryption and local backup specifications.
- [Onboarding & Setup Confirmation](https://www.inventory360.shop/thank-you): Confirmation and quick-start guide for newly configured workspaces.
- [XML Sitemap](https://www.inventory360.shop/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable XML sitemap of all public routes.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Nikking18/inventory360): Open-source source code, architecture documentation, and issue tracker.

## Technical Guides & Articles

- [Local-First POS System Architecture](https://www.inventory360.shop/blog/local-first-inventory-management-offline-pos): Building resilient, offline-capable retail ERPs with browser IndexedDB and Web Workers.
- [Inventory Turnover Ratio & Velocity Guide](https://www.inventory360.shop/blog/inventory-turnover-ratio-stock-velocity-guide): Formulating stock velocity, Days Sales of Inventory (DSI), and inventory turnover.
- [Omnichannel Retail Inventory Synchronization](https://www.inventory360.shop/blog/omnichannel-retail-inventory-sync-shopify-amazon): Real-time multi-platform inventory syncing for Shopify, Amazon, and physical stores.
- [Barcode Label Printing Hardware Workflows](https://www.inventory360.shop/blog/barcode-label-printing-hardware-workflows): Direct thermal vs thermal transfer printing, Code-128 barcode symbology, and 2-inch retail labels.
- [FIFO Lot Tracking & Expiry Management](https://www.inventory360.shop/blog/lot-tracking-expiry-date-management): Batch tracking compliance, perishable inventory workflows, and first-in-first-out stock rotation.
- [Purchase Order Automation & Reorder Points](https://www.inventory360.shop/blog/purchase-order-automation-reorder-points): Dynamic safety stock calculation, supplier lead time tracking, and autonomous PO generation.
- [Retail Margin Analysis & Profit Formulas](https://www.inventory360.shop/blog/retail-margin-analysis-gross-profit-formulas): Markup vs margin formulas, keystone pricing, and contribution margin optimization.
- [Multi-Outlet Stock Transfer Logistics](https://www.inventory360.shop/blog/multi-outlet-stock-transfers-logistics): Inter-store transit manifests, transfer audits, and regional warehouse allocation.
- [Physical Inventory Count Procedures](https://www.inventory360.shop/blog/physical-inventory-count-audit-procedures): Blind cycle counting, shrinkage calculation, and wall-to-wall stock audits.
- [Customer Lifetime Value in Retail POS](https://www.inventory360.shop/blog/customer-lifetime-value-crm-retail-pos): RFM segmentation, cohort analysis, and customer retention strategies.
- [Retail Loss Prevention & Shrinkage Telemetry](https://www.inventory360.shop/blog/retail-loss-prevention-inventory-shrinkage): Cashier auditing, transaction voids, and loss prevention controls.
- [Dead Stock Liquidation & Cash Flow](https://www.inventory360.shop/blog/dead-stock-liquidation-cash-flow): Markdown schedules, product bundling, and working capital recovery.
- [Thermal Receipt Printer ESC/POS Integration](https://www.inventory360.shop/blog/thermal-receipt-printer-esc-pos-integration): Web Serial API, WebUSB, and low-level ESC/POS hex commands for 80mm/58mm printers.
